data.title: 信浓 · 记下清晨第一道潮线
data.description: 潮水刚过石桩的第一道刻度，信浓便俯下身，用手指在水线旁比了一下。靛蓝裹身泳衣外的星纹薄纱被海风吹向身后，水边那一点新升的日光，恰好照亮了月牙别针。
data.location: 海边防波堤内侧有潮尺的浅潮池
data.action: 站在浅水中，指向石桩上的新潮位
data.lighting: 晨光由海面反射到潮尺和银色刺绣上
data.camera: 平视侧面全身，潮尺和水线各有留白
data.promptProse: Shinano stands in a sheltered tide pool and points to the first mark on a stone tide gauge as the new waterline reaches it. The opaque indigo wrap swimsuit is covered by a star-embroidered chiffon drape that lifts behind her in the sea breeze. Early daylight catches the silver stitching and her crescent pin.
data.animaCaption: Her hand stops beside the measuring mark as the next small ripple reaches the stone.
